newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Nacional de Chocolates Q1 net up.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Nacional de Chocolates Q1 net up.

text.p: The first-quarter net profit of Colombia's Compania Nacional de Chocolates rose 18.4 percent over a year ago to 10.7 billion pesos, the company said in a statement.

It said operating income at the company, which is Colombia's largest food maker and owned by the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, rose to 74.4 billion pesos from 62.8 billion in the first quarter of 1996.
The company's total assets rose 32.3 percent in the first quarter versus a year ago to 719.9 billion pesos, the earnings statement said.
